governing_rule: If it can be definitionally reduced, it is not an admissible authoritative leaf.

exact_source_assertion_scope.rule: Each IA-eligible A0 assertion is mapped to strict native kernel structure and marked CLOSED_TO_STRICT_KERNEL.

strict_ia_bodies.semantics: route phase relation equals final residual-bit relation on both shortest routes
XOR invariance under simultaneous input complement
relative target/source XOR equals represented final residual bit in every target-split solution
shortest 5x4 route phases XOR to one
explicit 4x4 route phases XOR to zero

reducible_kernel_relations.expansion: two-edge phase is IFF over path incidence, edge incidence and XOR truth table
three-edge phase is IFF over path incidence, edge incidence and iterated XOR
transporter inversion bit is IFF over exact slot-pair, transporter map, strict order and Boolean values
transporter sign is IFF over the ten inversion bits and iterated XOR
transporter bijection is expanded into totality and uniqueness in both directions

raw_atom_rule: Internal structure of a raw atom is omitted only when the exact claim uses that atom solely for identity/value and every load-bearing behavior is represented by incidence.
qu_scope_rule: These QU_UNEXPANDED nodes are outside the strict exact IA support cone; they preserve unresolved generalization and therefore do not block the narrowed exact rendering.
exact_closure_claim: Every authoritative exact IA body and every load-bearing relation in its dependency cone terminates in Core primitive logic or exact raw finite incidence/value atoms.
nonclaim: No primitive-completeness claim is made for the aggregate full-carrier census views or unresolved generalized QUs.
